response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_group_avgs FROM g

assumptions.assumption: 'Award vote records' means player_award_vote, the table of votes for player awards. manager_award_vote also has player_id but is about manager awards.
A blank death country means NULL, an empty string, or whitespace only. These players are excluded before grouping.

The 'simple average of the group averages' is the unweighted mean of the per-country averages over all remaining countries, including the current one. Each country's difference is its average minus that mean.
A country whose points_won values are all NULL still appears, with a NULL average and NULL difference. It is skipped when computing the mean of group averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Use manager award votes (manager_award_vote) instead of player award votes.
